title: case.resolved payload (v1)
description: Case resolved (terminal). Emitted by cases via the transactional outbox with the case state change. Producer: cases. Exchange: aegispulse.domain. FRs: FR-CASE-02, FR-CASE-03. Describes only the envelope `payload` (PROJECT.md §6.4, §6.7); consumers ignore unknown fields (NFR-13).
